ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA}^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then BASE="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; elif git rev-parse --verify --quiet "HEAD^" >/dev/null 2>&1; then BASE="HEAD^"; else exit 1; fi; git diff --quiet "$BASE" HEAD -- .; rc=$?; [ $rc -gt 1 ] && exit 1 || exit $rc
